rows.source_inscription: Stereoisomeric olefins or cycloalkanes (or hetero-analogues) which differ in the positions of atoms (or groups) relative to a reference plane: in the cis - isomer the atoms are on the same side, in the trans - isomer they are on opposite sides. Source: PAC, 1996, 68 , 2193. ( Basic terminology of stereochemistry (IUPAC Recommendations 1996) ) on page 2204 [ Terms ] [ Paper ]

rows.source_inscription: One of a pair of molecular entities which are mirror images of each other and non- superposable . See also: enantiomorph Sources: PAC, 1994, 66 , 1077. ( Glossary of terms used in physical organic chemistry (IUPAC Recommendations 1994) ) on page 1112 [ Terms ] [ Paper ] PAC, 1996, 68 , 2193.
